expires_tomorrow.title: Tales From the Iron Kingdoms
expires_tomorrow.description: Step into a world forged in steam and iron and tempered by war
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
In Warmachine the earth shakes during fierce confrontations between six-ton constructs of iron and steel clash with the devastating force of a locomotive, towering warbeasts hurl themselves at their foes in a frenzy of claw and fang, and bold heroes set the battlefield ablaze with with a tempest of of arcane magic as they forge the fate of nations in the fires of destruction.

Immerse yourself in Warmachine lore with this bundle of novels and short story anthologies, set in iconic locations and telling the stories of heroes, villains, and some of the Iron Kingdoms' most pivotal events. Collect each volume of the Iron Kingdoms Excursions, Warcaster Chronicles, Warlock Sagas, and Called to Battle series and more as you learn the backstories of key characters like The Butcher of Khardov and encounter a wealth of different peoples and cultures.

Grab this 41-ebook bundle at the price of your choice, and support the Child's Play charity with your purchase!

Also returning by popular demand is a collection of 65 Iron Kingdoms RPG (IKRPG) items, including core and source books for the Full Metal Fantasy and 5e editions, GM toolkits, bestiary's, and maps, first presented in the March 2025 Iron Kingdoms Humble Bundle.

A world of adventure and full metal fantasy awaits in the Iron Kingdoms.

expires_within_72h.title: The Greg Bear Birthday Bundle by Open Road Media
expires_within_72h.description: Celebrate the birthday of one of sci-fi’s masters
expires_within_72h.long_description: The world of science fiction lost a titan when novelist Greg Bear passed away in 2022, but his books remain a perfect example of exactly what sci-fi was always meant to be. Author of over 50 books and co-founder of San Diego Comic Con, Bear made loving sci-fi into a career that spanned five decades. His work, which tested the limits of human (and non-human) consciousness and looked toward the far future and beyond, inspires and excites readers to this day. To celebrate what would have been Greg Bear’s 75th Birthday, in partnership with Open Road Media, we’ve collected a bundle of his best novels including award-winning classics like first contact thriller Eon, alien invasion drama The Forge of God, and post-apocalyptic space odyssey Anvil of Stars! Get a motherlode of some of the best sci-fi ever written for the price of your choosing, and support the Science Fiction & Fantasy Writers Association with your purchase!
